hard_constraints: Do not claim SPRINT_COMPLETE if any taskcard is PENDING
Do not claim SPRINT_COMPLETE if final IV is not PASS
Do not claim SPRINT_COMPLETE if closeout and iv-results.json disagree
Do not claim SPRINT_COMPLETE if sidecar is missing or does not match actual bundle bytes
Do not claim SPRINT_COMPLETE if closeout SHA/size/entry count differ from actual bundle
Do not publish or PR a package with unresolved canonical URL ambiguity
Do not claim current canonical URL verification using only old /net/ catalog hashes
Bundled IV_FAIL cannot coexist with final closeout SPRINT_COMPLETE
closeout SHA must match actual zip bytes at bundle finalization time
sidecar_protocol_v11_notes: v1.1 adds: (1) bundle must be FROZEN before closeout is written, (2) iv-results.json must be re-run and restaged BEFORE bundle is built, (3) closeout sha256 field must be populated ONLY from the frozen bundle not an intermediate build
wave14_defects_addressed: W14-CONTRA-01: Bundled IV_FAIL with SPRINT_COMPLETE closeout
W14-CONTRA-04: IV re-run after bundle finalization, not before
W14-CONTRA-05: Bundle frozen mid-process with stale iv-results.json
W14-CONTRA-06: Old /net/ catalog URLs promoted without current canonical browser proof
W14-CONTRA-07: Incomplete root/browser verification deferred without explicit policy
